title: 1С:ERP vendor functionality and course-topic crosswalk
scope: Crosswalk of the 18 entries in the official 1С:ERP functionality navigation to the seven RPD/index topics and current local student-facing course material. It describes the public vendor navigation and observable local material only; it does not establish the classroom configuration, lesson delivery, student mastery, or exhaustive implementation of product functions.

statusVocabulary.direct: A local student-facing material directly treats this subject; this does not mean complete product-area coverage or confirmed lesson delivery.
statusVocabulary.narrow/partial: Local material directly treats only a bounded part of the broader product area.
statusVocabulary.adjacent-only: No direct treatment of this product area's functions or workflows in 1C:ERP was identified; a local material may still define the concept or mention the area contextually.
statusVocabulary.no-evidence: No qualifying local course material for this product area was identified in the reviewed index and corpus.

erpFunctionalityNavigation.evidence: All 18 functionality-navigation links were opened. They are vendor product overviews and do not prove the configuration or use of the classroom database.

catalogue.evidence: The live cross-product catalogue displayed 14 top-level functional-task categories and five nested subcategories in the checked view.

erpProductCard.evidence: The product card displayed release 2.6.2.76 dated 2026-11-16. This observation does not identify the release or configuration used in class.

itsDocumentationIndex.evidence: The general documentation list distinguishes ERP 2.6 from ERP 2.5 LTS. No 2.5 source is substituted for 2.6 evidence.

itsErp26Contents.evidence: The 2.6 contents and several chapter indexes were available. Bookmark pages may expose only a chapter index/iframe; iframe body access varied between HTTP 200 and 401. A 200 chapter index is not a full procedural-text review. One browser request to the purchasing-agreements page returned 403, while its shell returned 200 and iframe body returned 401.

displayedProductRelease.interpretationLimit: Product-card display only; not evidence that this release or configuration was used in the course.

its26AccessStatuses.200_chapter_index_only: HTTP 200 exposed the chapter index or list of questions; child procedures/full chapter text were not thereby verified.
its26AccessStatuses.401_title_only: HTTP 401 at the inspected document body; only the chapter/page title was available from the general contents.
its26AccessStatuses.no_defensible_page: No defensible matching 2.6 page was identified in the checked contents. This does not prove that no relevant feature or documentation exists.

catalogueTaxonomyLimit: The 14 top-level and five nested categories are cross-product catalogue taxonomy, not ERP modules, RPD topics, or evidence of course coverage.
exclusions: Do not infer the classroom 1С:ERP version, configuration, enabled modules, or settings from the public product card or vendor functionality pages.
Do not infer course delivery, completion, student attendance, assessment, or mastery from a listed or prepared page.
Do not treat the cross-product catalogue categories as one installation's modules or as the course structure.
Do not infer detailed procedure from a 2.6 chapter title or contents index alone.
Do not use ERP 2.5 LTS to fill a missing ERP 2.6 source.
